versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.0 — Major update with expanded capabilities and new documentation.

- Now supports automated scraping from the Ministry of Education, Ministry of Human Resources, and all provincial education department websites.
- Adds advanced filtering: keyword, date range, category, and source filters.
- Implements periodic summary/report generation (daily/weekly/monthly, by topic or region).
- Provides bilingual documentation and command line usage examples (Chinese/English).
- Includes detailed workflow, output formats, scheduled scraping setup, export/format conversion, and internationalization support.
- Documents ClawHub display name/system field limitations and slug requirements.
